families.name: name_component
families.definition: The role of one exact internal name component. Middle/other means name material that is neither reliably given nor family name. Separate nonoverlapping components of one person-name carrier receive separate decisions. A bare initial is Q: it stands for a name without being one, so given, middle and family would each be a labeling error rather than a guess.
families.Q_definition: An exact within-carrier region reliably known not to be name material, such as an honorific or punctuation outside a name component. Any actual name material that is neither reliably given nor family name is middle/other; unresolved actual name tokens and mononyms are unknown and omitted, not Q.

sequence_grammar.description: Sort component spans by source position, remove Q components, map the remaining values through the declared symbols, and require a full regular-expression match. This is the v1 language written explicitly: family name may be the sole, first, or last non-Q component but never an interior component; middle/other may occur once at any position and therefore never recurs or alternates. Given-name components remain unrestricted, matching v1 behavior.

families.name: government_id_kind
families.definition: The single established kind of one government-identifier span.
families.Q_definition: The identifier is reliably known to be outside the modeled kinds; generic or unresolved government IDs are unknown and omitted.

families.name: place_coarseness
families.definition: The jurisdiction-relative rung of one complete place span. Municipality and settlement share primary_locality.
families.Q_definition: A reliably resolved but deliberately unmodeled place rung; an ambiguous district or omitted address component is unknown and omitted.

families.name: jurisdiction_nation
families.definition: The single resolved jurisdiction nation of one complete place or government-ID span.
families.Q_definition: The jurisdiction is reliably resolved but is outside the modeled nation inventory; merely copying the document country is not resolution.

families.name: currency_identity
families.definition: The single resolved currency or ledger identity of one complete amount or account span.
families.Q_definition: The currency is reliably resolved but is outside the modeled inventory; an ambiguous symbol is unknown and omitted.

training_contract.conditioning: Each family block is conditioned on the activating ordinary primary type.
training_contract.coverage: A full_primary_span value applies to every character and overlapping model token of the exact carrier. A component_span value applies to every character and overlapping token of the exact declared internal component.
training_contract.unknown: A missing family/component is masked and never converted to Q.
training_contract.loss_unit: A full_primary_span family uses one categorical cross-entropy after length-normalized logit pooling. A component_span family uses token-local categorical cross-entropy over the component, with its total component weight divided across overlapping model tokens.
training_contract.weight_initialization: Each subclass objective_weight initially inherits its carrier primary-span objective weight. Its independent learning_weight defaults to 1.0; effective optimization mass is objective_weight times learning_weight.
training_contract.ordinary_primary_loss: Primary BIOES boundary/type loss remains independently weighted and unchanged; component-span subclass decoding does not enter the single-winner primary Viterbi lattice.

sidecar_families.name: reference_form
sidecar_families.definition: The surface form of one complete grounded non-name reference. Descriptive covers maximal grounded nominal or multiword pronominal expressions; symbolic_pseudonym covers publisher variables, anonymization codes, and other document-local symbolic carriers; bare_pronoun covers a carrier consisting solely of a pronominal expression.
sidecar_families.Q_definition: There is no Q outcome. Every projected reference requires exactly one reviewed value; unresolved form makes the row ineligible for materialization.
